figures.title: Statistical MaxRL: widths and estimators
figures.note: Full data, three seeds per setting. Five shared legend entries control both estimator rows. Solid: width 2; dashed: width 5. The same exact CE reference appears in both rows. Rates are independently validation-selected; this is not a matched-LR intervention.

figures.title: TailRL and supervised baselines
figures.note: Full data × 50 epochs, three matched seeds: sampled TailRL, population TailRL, scalar MAE and CE. TailRL peak LR: population 0.0001; 64 samples 0.001. Rates are independently validation-selected.

figures.title: Fixed training-label noise: four levels
figures.note: 4096 images × 50 epochs; optimization seed 42, noise seed 2026; held-out labels are clean. η = noise RMS / clean-age SD (about 0.05 at SD 1); conventional power SNR = 1/η². SD 3 replaces the unrun SD 2 by request. GRPO MAE is the best available clean-validation RL configuration; RLOO noise arms were not run.
